newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Tooth sees return to profitablity.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Tooth sees return to profitablity.

text.p: Tooth & Co Ltd, part of the debt-laden group Adelaide Steamship Co Ltd, said on Tuesday that changes to the group's financing arrangements give the company potential to return to profitability in 1996/97.
"...there now exists the potential to return to profitability in the new financial year," chairman Peter Cottrell told the company's annual meeting.
Cottrell said Tooth formed an agreement with its lenders in June this year for all existing financing arrangements to be extended for a further term of two years June 30, 1998.
Tooth & Co reported a net loss of A$3.98 million for the year to June 30, 1996, compared with a profit of A$1.18 million in 1994/95.
